name: Blacksmith's Talent
clause: When this Class enters, create a colorless Equipment artifact token named Sword with "Equipped creature gets +1/+1" and equip {2}. / At the beginning of combat on your turn, attach target Equipment you control to up to one target creature you control. / During your turn, equipped creatures you control have double strike and haste.

needs.proposedSignature: `{ op: 'attach', what: TargetSpec | Ref, to: TargetSpec | Ref, upTo?: boolean }`
needs.semantics: 'Attach target Equipment you control to up to one target creature you control' (and 'attach target Aura to …'). attach-self attaches the SOURCE and attach-to-that attaches the source to the bound object; nothing moves a third object's attachment, so every 'attach target Equipment' card is unwritable.
needs.clause: At the beginning of combat on your turn, attach target Equipment you control to up to one target creature you control.

needs.proposedSignature: `token` gains `abilities?: Ability[]` (and, for the common Equipment case, an `equipCost?: ManaCost` shorthand that expands to the `equipment` static plus its equip ability)
needs.semantics: 'Create a colorless Equipment artifact token named Sword with "Equipped creature gets +1/+1" and equip {2}', and every Role / Map / custom-text token. The token op carries P/T, colors, types, subtypes, keywords and the predefined-token flags only; a token whose printed text is an ABILITY cannot be created, and _tokens.ts's BUILTIN_TOKEN_ABILITIES is a fixed by-name table a card cannot extend.
